recommendations.title: Split long JavaScript tasks to minimize Total Blocking Time
recommendations.description: Long tasks (>50ms) occupy the main browser thread, delaying input processing and degrading user responsiveness.

finding.description: Total Blocking Time of 635ms exceeds the 200ms recommended threshold across 19 long task(s) (longest: 118ms) | Script: unknown

recommendations.potentialImpact: Relieves main-thread CPU congestion and eliminates input latency during page load.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Break up long tasks (>50ms) using scheduler.yield() or requestIdleCallback(), defer non-critical JavaScript execution, and offload CPU-intensive work to Web Workers.
recommendations.issue: Split long JavaScript tasks to minimize Total Blocking Time
recommendations.whyItMatters: Relieves main-thread CPU congestion and eliminates input latency during page load.
recommendations.actualValue: Total Blocking Time: 635ms (19 long tasks, max: 118ms)
recommendations.reason: Long JavaScript tasks block the browser main thread from responding to user interactions.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Break up long tasks (>50ms) using scheduler.yield() or requestIdleCallback(), defer non-critical JavaScript execution, and offload CPU-intensive work to Web Workers.

recommendations.title: Purge unused CSS rules from stylesheets
recommendations.description: Shipping unused CSS selectors increases stylesheet transfer size and delays Render Tree construction.

finding.description: 121 KB of unused CSS rules measured via Chrome DevTools Protocol Coverage

recommendations.evidence: CDP coverage profile measured 121 KB of unused CSS rules across stylesheets
recommendations.potentialImpact: Reduces stylesheet transfer sizes and speeds up style recalculation.

estimatedSavings.assumption: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Fast 3G network profile (200 KB/s wire transfer rate; does NOT predict FCP/LCP/TBT improvement)
estimatedSavings.displayString: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.60s transfer on Fast 3G (121 KB @ 200 KB/s)

recommendations.suggestedFix: Remove dead CSS rules using PurgeCSS, uncss, or CSS module scoping so only utilized selectors are transmitted.
recommendations.issue: Purge unused CSS rules from stylesheets
recommendations.whyItMatters: Reduces stylesheet transfer sizes and speeds up style recalculation.
recommendations.estimatedImprovement: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.60s transfer on Fast 3G (121 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.estimatedPerformanceGain: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.60s transfer on Fast 3G (121 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.actualValue: 121 KB unused CSS rules measured via CDP
recommendations.expectedValue: Ship only CSS styles utilized by the current route and components
recommendations.reason: Unused CSS bloats network payloads and forces the browser to evaluate redundant CSS selectors.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Remove dead CSS rules using PurgeCSS, uncss, or CSS module scoping so only utilized selectors are transmitted.

recommendations.title: Extract critical CSS rules and defer non-critical styles
recommendations.description: External stylesheets block the browser from constructing the Render Tree until downloaded and parsed.

finding.description: 2 render-blocking external stylesheet(s) >10KB detected in document <head>

recommendations.evidence: Stylesheet https://vercel.com/vc-ap-vercel-marketing/_next/static/immutable/chunks/2qur219wein05.css (114.0 KB) blocks initial layout render in <head>
recommendations.potentialImpact: Unblocks Render Tree construction, allowing the browser to paint content earlier.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Inline critical above-the-fold CSS rules in a <style> block and load secondary stylesheets asynchronously with media="print" onload="this.media='all'".
recommendations.issue: Extract critical CSS rules and defer non-critical styles
recommendations.whyItMatters: Unblocks Render Tree construction, allowing the browser to paint content earlier.
recommendations.expectedValue: Inline critical above-the-fold CSS and load non-critical stylesheets asynchronously
recommendations.reason: External stylesheets in <head> block the browser from constructing the Render Tree until downloaded and parsed.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Inline critical above-the-fold CSS rules in a <style> block and load secondary stylesheets asynchronously with media="print" onload="this.media='all'".

recommendations.title: Minify CSS stylesheets to reduce weight
recommendations.description: Minifying CSS strips comments and redundant whitespace from stylesheets.

finding.description: 2 unminified stylesheet(s) detected with 123 KB potential reduction

recommendations.potentialImpact: Reduces stylesheet transfer sizes over the network.

estimatedSavings.assumption: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Fast 3G network profile (200 KB/s wire transfer rate; does NOT predict FCP/LCP/TBT improvement)
estimatedSavings.displayString: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.61s transfer on Fast 3G (123 KB @ 200 KB/s)

recommendations.suggestedFix: Minify production CSS using clean-css, cssnano, or esbuild during compilation.
recommendations.issue: Minify CSS stylesheets to reduce weight
recommendations.whyItMatters: Reduces stylesheet transfer sizes over the network.
recommendations.estimatedImprovement: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.61s transfer on Fast 3G (123 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.estimatedPerformanceGain: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.61s transfer on Fast 3G (123 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.expectedValue: All external CSS stylesheets should be minified with comments and whitespace stripped
recommendations.reason: Unminified CSS includes formatting whitespace and comments that expand file transfer size.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Minify production CSS using clean-css, cssnano, or esbuild during compilation.

recommendations.title: Compress page images and convert to next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF)
recommendations.description: WebP and AVIF image formats provide superior compression performance compared to legacy PNG/JPEG, reducing download latency.

finding.description: 2 uncompressed or legacy image(s) detected with 20 KB potential reduction

recommendations.evidence: Analyzed 2 images; sample: https://lishhsx6kmthaacj.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/notion-desktop-dark.webp can save 11.9 KB using WebP/AVIF
recommendations.potentialImpact: Reduces initial image payload bytes transmitted across the network.

estimatedSavings.assumption: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Fast 3G network profile (200 KB/s wire transfer rate; does NOT predict FCP/LCP/TBT improvement)
estimatedSavings.displayString: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.10s transfer on Fast 3G (20 KB @ 200 KB/s)

recommendations.suggestedFix: Optimize raw image assets using sharp, imagemin, or dynamic CDN image transforms to compress payloads and serve next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF).
recommendations.issue: Compress page images and convert to next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF)
recommendations.whyItMatters: Reduces initial image payload bytes transmitted across the network.
recommendations.estimatedImprovement: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.10s transfer on Fast 3G (20 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.estimatedPerformanceGain: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.10s transfer on Fast 3G (20 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.actualValue: 2 uncompressed or legacy image(s) (20 KB potential savings)
recommendations.expectedValue: Serve modern WebP or AVIF image formats compressed for web viewing
recommendations.reason: Legacy image formats transfer excess bytes over the network, consuming bandwidth.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Optimize raw image assets using sharp, imagemin, or dynamic CDN image transforms to compress payloads and serve next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF).

recommendations.title: Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images
recommendations.description: Deferring offscreen images reduces initial page network competition and payload weight.

finding.description: 7 below-the-fold image(s) loaded synchronously without loading="lazy"

recommendations.evidence: 7 img element(s) detected without loading="lazy" attribute
recommendations.potentialImpact: Relieves initial network contention by deferring image requests outside the viewport.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Add loading="lazy" attribute to all 7 images that appear below the viewport fold.
recommendations.issue: Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images
recommendations.whyItMatters: Relieves initial network contention by deferring image requests outside the viewport.
recommendations.expectedValue: Add loading="lazy" attribute to all non-hero images outside the initial viewport
recommendations.reason: Offscreen images load during critical page initialization, competing for network bandwidth.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Add loading="lazy" attribute to all 7 images that appear below the viewport fold.

recommendations.title: Properly size images to match rendered display dimensions
recommendations.description: Serving images with natural pixel dimensions significantly larger than rendered display dimensions wastes network bandwidth and memory.

finding.description: 2 image(s) exceed rendered display dimensions by >1.5x, transferring excess pixels

recommendations.evidence: 2 oversized image(s) detected; sample: https://vercel.com/vc-ap-vercel-marketing/_next/static/immutable/media/vercel-dark.1f3cgy23m5_jy.svg is 115x100 but rendered at 16x14
recommendations.potentialImpact: Reduces image download payload and browser image decoding/memory overhead.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Resize source images or implement responsive srcset/sizes attributes so the browser downloads image assets tailored to the viewport resolution.
recommendations.issue: Properly size images to match rendered display dimensions
recommendations.whyItMatters: Reduces image download payload and browser image decoding/memory overhead.
recommendations.expectedValue: Serve appropriately sized images matching display dimensions or use srcset/sizes
recommendations.reason: Large images scaled down via CSS waste download bytes and increase memory pressure.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Resize source images or implement responsive srcset/sizes attributes so the browser downloads image assets tailored to the viewport resolution.

recommendations.title: Add descriptive alt attributes to image tags
recommendations.description: Screen readers require descriptive alt text to convey visual content to users with vision impairments.

finding.description: 1 image tag(s) lack alternative text descriptions in the rendered DOM

recommendations.evidence: 1 tag(s) without valid alt attribute identified in DOM
recommendations.potentialImpact: Enables screen readers to describe visual content to visually impaired users.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Provide descriptive alt="..." text descriptions for all image tags (affecting ~1 images) or empty alt="" for purely decorative graphics.
recommendations.issue: Add descriptive alt attributes to image tags
recommendations.whyItMatters: Enables screen readers to describe visual content to visually impaired users.
recommendations.expectedValue: All tags must possess meaningful alt attributes or alt="" if purely decorative
recommendations.reason: Screen readers announce uncaptioned filenames when alt attributes are missing, degrading accessible user experience.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Provide descriptive alt="..." text descriptions for all image tags (affecting ~1 images) or empty alt="" for purely decorative graphics.
